help.html:
Qorashahar — classic Mafia
How to playGroup: /game. Everyone Join + DM. Host Start. Night: roles in DM. Day: talk, trial, confirm. Two inactive night turns — AFK death + last words. /extend /next /stop /roles /profile /shop /buy /top /settings.
Who winsBlack Hand ≥ survivors — darkness. Maniac / mage / crook solo. Snitch same target as Detective. Arsonist 3 lives. Suicide wins if lynched. Otherwise town.
Make the bot admin in the supergroup: restrict, pin, delete. @qorashahar_mafia_bot
